items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Do you know how to spell that?' and 'Would you know about what year that was...', but the interviewee does not respond with personal knowledge or interaction, only the interviewer provides details about seeing her.

ctx.x: I think it was the way they spelled it -- S-i-s-r-e-t-t-a -- Sisretta.
Sisretta Jones. And then you say she toured Europe, they gave her the nickname Black Patty?
Yeah, I think that's the way. (inaudible).
